title: Papyri Graecae Magicae (Preisendanz 1928–31); RU «Греческие магические папирусы» [RU-gap]; pilot PGM XIII
author: Anonymous Graeco-Egyptian ritual practitioners
size: c. 130 papyri; PGM IV alone 3,274 lines
edition: Preisendanz 1928–31 and Henrichs 2nd ed. 1973–74 (copyrighted; the early text may be free under German §70 UrhG, 25-year term — check)
ru_evidence: No scholarly Russian translation found. CyberLeninka shows studies only (e.g., on ψῆφος in magical contexts, ИЯКФ 2014). Esoteric amateur versions may exist.
en_evidence: Betz, The Greek Magical Papyri in Translation (1986), several archive.org records; Wikipedia 'Greek Magical Papyri'
other_translations: German (Preisendanz, facing translation); Spanish Gredos edition (from memory)
value: Central for Graeco-Egyptian religion, Hermetism, Judaism, early Christianity and ancient magic; heavily used across disciplines.
ai_feasibility: medium: voces magicae, ritual technicalities, bilingual passages
pilot_unit: PGM XIII (Eighth Book of Moses), c. 1,000 lines
